arguments.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id, p.height
    FROM main.Player AS p
    WHERE p.birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND p.birthday < '1996-01-01'
), grades AS (
    SELECT a.player_api_id, a.defensive_work_rate,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.player_api_id ORDER BY a.date DESC) AS recency
    FROM main.Player_Attributes AS a
    JOIN cohort AS c ON c.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
    WHERE a.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
), latest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(DISTINCT defensive_work_rate) AS grade_count
    FROM grades WHERE recency = 1 GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cohort_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS unique_players,
       MIN(height) AS min_height, MAX(height) AS max_height,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE grade_count > 1) AS conflicting_latest_grades
FROM cohort

WITH ranked_grades AS (
    SELECT p.height,
           a.defensive_work_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.player_api_id
               ORDER BY a.date DESC, a.id DESC
           ) AS recency
    FROM main.Player AS p
    JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.birthday >= '1990-01-01'
      AND p.birthday < '1996-01-01'
      AND a.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM ranked_grades
WHERE recency = 1 AND defensive_work_rate = 'medium'
LIMIT 1
